title: Vanilla 2.0
description: Vanilla 2.0 Client Pack improves Minecraft with better visuals, smoother performance, and quality of life features while keeping the core vanilla gameplay intact.
body:
# 🌿 Vanilla 2.0 Client

Vanilla 2.0 Client is the companion client modpack designed to enhance the visual experience, performance, and usability of Minecraft while remaining faithful to the original vanilla gameplay.

Unlike large overhaul modpacks, Vanilla 2.0 focuses on refinement rather than replacement. The goal is to make Minecraft feel smoother, clearer, and more immersive without changing how the game fundamentally works.

This pack is built to work seamlessly alongside the Vanilla 2.0 Server Pack, ensuring players experience the world exactly as intended while benefiting from client-side improvements.

---

## 🎨 Visuals

The client pack enhances the visual presentation of Minecraft while keeping the classic vanilla aesthetic intact. Subtle improvements to rendering and lighting help the game feel more polished without altering the familiar look of the world.

These enhancements allow players to enjoy:

* cleaner rendering
* smoother lighting transitions
* improved visual clarity during exploration
* a more vibrant and immersive environment

The result is a world that still feels like vanilla Minecraft, but more alive and visually refined.

---

## ⚡ Performance

Vanilla 2.0 includes several client-side optimizations that significantly improve performance and frame stability.

These optimizations help by:

* increasing FPS
* reducing micro-stutters
* improving chunk rendering speed
* optimizing memory usage

This makes the pack suitable for both high-end systems and lower-end computers.

---

## 🧭 Quality of Life

The client pack includes small usability improvements designed to make everyday gameplay more comfortable and intuitive.

These improvements help with:

* better interface usability
* clearer information display
* smoother interaction with the game world
* improved overall user experience

None of these changes modify the core mechanics of Minecraft.

---

## 🔗 Compatibility

Vanilla 2.0 Client is designed to be used together with the Vanilla 2.0 Server Pack.

Using both packs together ensures:

* full compatibility with server features
* smoother multiplayer gameplay
* a consistent experience between client and server

---

## 🎯 Philosophy

The philosophy behind Vanilla 2.0 is simple: enhance Minecraft without replacing it.

Every improvement included in the client pack follows three principles:

* preserve vanilla gameplay
* improve performance and usability
* enhance immersion without overcomplicating the game

---

## ⭐ Experience

With the Vanilla 2.0 Client you can expect:

* smoother gameplay and higher frame rates
* improved visual clarity
* subtle quality of life improvements
* seamless compatibility with Vanilla 2.0 servers

Vanilla 2.0 refines the vanilla experience to make Minecraft smoother, cleaner, and more enjoyable to play.
